metadata.title: Cultural Resonance & Aesthetic Sovereignty
metadata.notes: Using art and language to maintain social network coherence.

nodes.title: Sonic Mesh-Weaving
nodes.description: The physics of collective rhythm. Synchronizing high-frequency signals across a decentralized network. Using the mesh for collaborative acoustic resonance and 'Mesh-Music'.

nodes.title: Linguistic Resurrection & Semantic Mapping
nodes.description: Preserving world-views. Mapping endangered and local idioms into the HDC semantic mesh. Understanding why linguistic diversity is a prerequisite for collective intelligence.

nodes.title: Muralism & The Memory of the Commons
nodes.description: Visualizing the ledger. Techniques for large-scale spatial storytelling and public art that anchors a community's historical lineage and moral obligations.

nodes.title: The Psychology of Resonance
nodes.description: Flow states and collective effervescence. The neuro-biology of belonging and the role of shared aesthetic experience in preventing network-scale 'Burnout'.

nodes.title: The Resonance Capstone
nodes.description: Organize a 'Convergence Event' (ritual, performance, or council) that effectively binds a multi-pod cluster together, as verified by increased social-endorsement velocity.

holonic_capstone.deliverable: A verified 'Artifact of Coherence' (recording, mural, or transcript) and a documented increase in peer-trust markers post-event.

edges.rationale: Collective aesthetics provide the theoretical foundation for sonic mesh-weaving.
True resonance requires the inclusion of diverse linguistic world-views.
Leading a convergence requires deep understanding of the psychology of belonging.
